notes:
I couldn't write the notes for 2 Peter 2. I hit the tool limit before any page loaded. My first attempt tried to open seven pages at once (Enduring Word, Precept Austin, the Ellicott, Gill and Pulpit commentaries on Bible Hub, the NET Bible notes, and Wesley's Notes) and failed with a "limit exceeded" error. After that, no searches or page loads were allowed, so I read nothing from any approved site.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I haven't written any verse notes. Anything I wrote now would be unsourced.

**What I'd do next time.** I'd open pages one or two at a time so I don't hit the limit, in this order:

1. **Verse-by-verse basics:** Enduring Word, then the Ellicott, Gill and Pulpit commentaries on Bible Hub, then Precept Austin.
2. **Verses where traditions disagree:**
   - **v. 1 ("denying the Master who bought them"):** whether Christ died for everyone or only for the saved. I'd compare Reformed writers (Monergism, Ligonier, Desiring God, GTY) with Wesleyan ones (Wesley's Notes, Seedbed).
   - **vv. 20–22:** whether a true believer can fall away for good. I'd compare the same Reformed and Baptist sources with Wesleyan, Pentecostal (AG) and Lutheran (LCMS, 1517) ones.
3. **Other views:**
   - **v. 4 ("deep into hell"):** the NET Bible notes (Peter uses the Greek word "Tartarus") and Bible Odyssey, which may also link these angels to Genesis 6.
   - **Catholic and Orthodox readings:** New Advent (Church Fathers), Catholic.com and OCA.
   - **v. 3 (greedy teachers) and v. 19 (promised freedom):** any discussion of prosperity or hyper-grace teaching.

If you send the request again, I'll follow that plan and give you sourced notes verse by verse.
